posts.caption:
Raw iron or non-stick? You don't have to pick anymore.

Raw iron is strong but heavy, and it rusts if you skip the seasoning. Ordinary non-stick is easy, until it warps and peels.

Tawaana puts a PFOA-free granite non-stick coating on a super lightweight iron body. Even heat, nothing sticks, no seasoning, no rust.

Swipe for the side-by-side. tawaana.com

posts.title: 4 habits that make your tawa last
posts.caption:
Want your tawa to look new for years? Four small habits.

1. Wooden or silicone spatulas only
2. Low-to-medium flame, 1 to 2 minute preheat
3. Let it cool, then wash with a soft sponge
4. Dry it fully and hang it by the loop

Do this, and your 1-year replacement warranty has your back too.

Save this for later. Full care guide at tawaana.com
